props.name: asChild
props.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

props.name: defaultPaths
props.description:
The default paths of the signature pad.
Use when you don't need to control the paths of the signature pad.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the signature pad is disabled.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the signature pad elements. Useful for composition.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the signature pad. Useful for form submission.

props.name: onDraw
props.description:
Callback when the signature pad is drawing or the committed paths change.
`paths` contains only committed strokes; use `currentPath` for the in-progress stroke.

props.name: onDrawEnd
props.description: Callback when the signature pad is done drawing.

props.name: paths
props.description: The controlled paths of the signature pad.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the signature pad is read-only.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the signature pad is required.

props.name: translations
props.description: The translations of the signature pad. Useful for internationalization.
